name: defibro-monorepo
description: DeFibro - Plataforma de gestión DeFi completa
author: DeFibro Team

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" --names "🔥 Backend,⚡ Frontend" --prefix-colors "red,blue" --kill-others-on-fail
scripts.dev:all: npm run dev:db && npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend" --names "🔥 Backend,⚡ Frontend" --prefix-colors "red,blue"
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:watch: concurrently "npm run test:backend -- --watch" "npm run test:frontend -- --watch" --names "🧪 Backend Tests,🧪 Frontend Tests"
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:backend -- --fix && npm run lint:frontend -- --fix
scripts.clean: npm run clean:backend && npm run clean:frontend && npm run clean:deps
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run dev:db
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build && npm run docker:build && npm run docker:up
scripts.deploy:prod: NODE_ENV=production npm run build && docker-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d
